title: From a Scalar to a Matrix Setting for the Dai--Liao Parameter
summary: As is well known, both the numerical performance and the theoretical properties of the Dai--Liao conjugate gradient algorithm are highly dependent on the adjustment of its key parameter. Here, we first employ the well-known Harmonic--Geometric--Arithmetic--Quadratic mean inequality to reinforce the optimality of two previously proposed scalar adaptive settings of the Dai--Liao parameter. In other words, we show how these parameter choices are capable of enhancing the well-conditioning of the Dai--Liao search direction matrix by shrinking the intervals containing its singular values.
